players.name: RJ Barrett
players.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Nolan Traore
players.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

players.name: Moritz Wagner
players.comment: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.
